prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: can I add a DOD number for TSA precheck to an existing flight reservation?
Delta: Sure. May I have your confirmation and TSA PreCheck number, please? *TDH

Customer: how do I add my tsa # to an upcoming flight?
Delta: Hey Dave, I am able to assist with adding your TSA Precheck number to your reservation. Please DM your TSA number and confirmation number. *AJY https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: Just got boarding passes for tomorrow and no TSA Precheck?
Delta: Please try checking in once more. *HKC

Customer: my flight today my Tsa precheck didn’t show up. How Can you fix this for Sunday?
Delta: Can you DM your confirmation # to the link provided? I will look into this for you.  *TBT https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: general_question):
"""can you verify that my TSA Precheck number is attached to my upcoming flight tomorrow?"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Sure thing! Please DM us your confirmation number and TSA PreCheck number so we can verify it’s attached to your flight.
